parameters.jsCode:
const story = $json.STORY_ENGINE || {
  category: $json.STORY_CATEGORY,
  topic: $json.STORY_TOPIC,
  hook: $json.STORY_HOOK,
  lesson: $json.STORY_LESSON,
};

const prompt = `
YOUTUBE SHORTS PACKAGE GENERATOR

Use this Story Engine output as the only content source:
${JSON.stringify(story, null, 2)}

Create one ForgeView YouTube Shorts package.

Rules:
- Output valid JSON only.
- Fields: title, description, narration_script, tags, scene1, scene2, scene3, scene4, scene5, scene6, scene7.
- Title max 100 characters.
- Description must include exactly these links and #Shorts:
Telegram:
https://t.me/ForgeViewCom

X:
https://x.com/ForgeViewX

#Shorts
- Tags must be an array of 4 to 8 grounded tags.
- Scenes must follow this structure:
scene1: hook
scene2: hidden problem
scene3: what breaks
scene4: why it matters
scene5: what ForgeView changed or learned
scene6: proof or operational takeaway
scene7: final principle
- Each scene: 2 to 7 words.
- Narration script: serious, clear, builder explaining a real ForgeView lesson.
- Do not invent fake metrics, customers, revenue, trading results, or product launches.
- Do not use random AI/business advice.
- Stay grounded in the Story Engine category, topic, hook, and lesson.

Return JSON only.
`;

return [{
  json: {
    ...$json,
    SHORTS_PROMPT: prompt,
  }
}];
